seoTitle: Mad Men Test: Which Character Are You? (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Mad Men test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Don, Peggy, Joan, Roger, Pete or Betty — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the mystery, the self-made woman, or the one who runs everything? Answer 10 everyday questions about work, ambition and keeping up appearances, and find out which Mad Men character you are.

characters.name: Don Draper
characters.title: The Mystery
characters.summary: Brilliant, charming and impossible to read. You've got a gift, and a few secrets you'll never share.
description: Like Don, you've got a gift. He's the brilliant creative director at the advertising agency Sterling Cooper, and later a founding partner of his own firm.
You've got a secret. Don was born Dick Whitman, and he took on the identity of another man, Donald Draper.
You keep searching. In the finale, Don ends up at a retreat in California, and the show cuts to the famous 1971 "Hilltop" Coca-Cola ad.
characters.flaw: When things get hard, you disappear.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a long silence and an idea that changes everything.
characters.clashReason: they'd vanish for days and act like nothing happened

characters.name: Peggy Olson
characters.title: The Self-Made Woman
characters.summary: Talented, determined and underestimated. You work harder than anyone, and you prove them all wrong.
description: Like Peggy, you're more talented than people expect. She starts at Sterling Cooper as Don's secretary.
You work your way up. Peggy becomes a copywriter, and later a chief copywriter.
You learn from the best. Peggy's creative partnership with Don is one of the most important relationships in her life.
characters.flaw: You work so hard that you forget to have a life outside the office.
characters.signature: A notepad full of ideas, a late night at the office and a point to prove.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep working through every plan you made

characters.name: Joan Holloway
characters.title: The One Who Runs Everything
characters.summary: Poised, sharp and always in control. You know how everything works, and nothing gets past you.
description: Like Joan, you know how everything works. She starts as the office manager at Sterling Cooper.
You rise to the top. Joan becomes a partner in the firm.
You make your own way. When the agency is absorbed by McCann Erickson, Joan starts her own company.
characters.flaw: You'd rather handle everything yourself than let anyone see you struggle.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a sharp eye and a plan for everything.
characters.clashReason: they'd fix your mistake before you'd noticed it, and let you know

characters.name: Roger Sterling
characters.title: The Charmer
characters.summary: Witty, carefree and born lucky. You make everything look effortless, and you always have a line ready.
description: Like Roger, you were born into it. He's one of the managing partners of Sterling Cooper, the agency his father co-founded.
You know how to keep people happy. Roger looks after Lucky Strike, one of the agency's most valuable clients.
You like a little drama. Roger has a long, on-and-off affair with Joan.
characters.flaw: You've never had to try very hard, and it shows.
characters.signature: A silver tongue, a long lunch and a joke for every occasion.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke when you wanted them to take it seriously

characters.name: Pete Campbell
characters.title: The Ambitious One
characters.summary: Driven, competitive and desperate for respect. You want to get ahead, and you want everyone to know it.
description: Like Pete, you want to get ahead. He's an account executive at Sterling Cooper, and he was born into money.
You're competitive. Pete grows more and more competitive with Don over the years.
You get there in the end. Pete becomes a partner at the agency.
characters.flaw: You want credit so badly that you complain when you don't get it.
characters.signature: A new suit, a big account and a chip on your shoulder.
characters.clashReason: they'd sulk for a week because you got the credit

characters.name: Betty Draper
characters.title: The Perfect Housewife
characters.summary: Elegant, proud and not as content as you look. You keep up appearances, whatever's going on inside.
description: Like Betty, you look the part. She's a former model who went to Bryn Mawr, and she gives up her career to raise her family.
You're not as content as you look. Betty is the classic dissatisfied 1960s housewife.
You start over. Betty divorces Don and marries Henry Francis.
characters.flaw: You'd rather look perfect than admit you're unhappy.
characters.signature: Perfect hair, a cool stare and a lot left unsaid.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you the silent treatment and look flawless doing it

questions.text: You're asked to pitch an idea with no time to prepare. You...

options.text: Go quiet, then deliver something brilliant and moving
Pitch it anyway, and prove you belong in the room
Make a joke, and charm them into giving you more time
Wing it, then blame the client if it flops

questions.text: You've got a free Saturday. You...

options.text: Finally get an afternoon to yourself, and curl up with a book
Have a very long lunch, full of good stories
Work. You've got something to prove
Go for a long drive, alone, with no destination

questions.text: The office is in chaos. You...

options.text: Calmly take control, and have it running by lunch
Make a witty remark, and leave someone else to deal with it
See it as a chance to make yourself look good
Find your work buddy, and get through it together

questions.text: Your boss praises someone else for your idea. You...

options.text: Speak up. You earned it, and you're not staying quiet
Make sure everyone knows how unfair it is
Say nothing, and quietly make yourself impossible to ignore
Shrug. Ideas are the one thing you'll never run out of

questions.text: You're unhappy in your relationship. You...

options.text: Act like everything's perfect, and keep it to yourself
Disappear for a while, then come back like nothing happened
Find a new romance. Life's too short
Stay practical, and make your own plan
Stand in the corner looking mysterious, and let people come to you
Charm the host, and leave with a new client
Find the most important person there, and get in with them
Look flawless, and quietly judge everyone

questions.text: A friend asks for honest feedback on their work. You...

options.text: Tell them the truth, kindly but clearly
Tell them what you really think, and not gently
Give them one sentence that changes everything
Point out exactly what's wrong, and how to fix it

questions.text: You get a big raise. You...

options.text: Buy a bigger house, so everyone can see you've made it
Spend it on a beautiful new wardrobe
Put it toward being your own boss one day
Celebrate in style, and pick up the check

questions.text: You work at a 1960s ad agency where nobody takes women seriously. You...

options.text: Outwork everyone until they have no choice
Run the whole place from behind the scenes
Smile, then go home and quietly resent it
Don't notice the problem. It's never affected you

questions.text: You're living under a stolen identity, and nobody knows. You...

options.text: Keep the secret forever, and become the best version of the new you
Tell the one person you trust most
Use it to get ahead, and hope nobody digs
Help keep it hidden, and make sure you're owed a favor
